title: Coconut Shrimp
description: These coconut shrimp are dipped in beer batter, covered in coconut, then fried until golden, sweet, and crisp for a tasty appetizer or main dish.
ingredients: 24 medium raw shrimp, shelled, deveined, with tails attached

steps.text: Line a baking sheet with wax paper; set aside.
Whisk together 1/2 cup flour, beer, egg, and baking powder in a medium bowl until smooth. Place coconut and remaining 1/4 cup flour in 2 separate bowls.

One at a time, hold shrimp by the tail and dredge in flour, shaking off excess. Dip in beer batter; allow excess to drip off. Roll in coconut, then place on the prepared baking sheet. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat oil in a deep fryer or large skillet to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Working in batches, fry shrimp in hot oil, turning once, until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes. Use tongs to remove shrimp to paper towels to drain.

video.description: Enjoy crispy coconut shrimp without taking a trip to the beach! In this video, the Allrecipes team shows you how to make the classic appetizer quickly and easily. After dipping the shrimp in a flavorful beer batter and flaked coconut, refrigerate them for around 30 minutes. Once the shrimp has chilled, fry them in oil over the stove until golden brown and crunchy. Whether it’s the main course or a side, this delicious seafood recipe is as good as it gets!
